decisions.statement: A writer is stated as the name and address git takes as an author.
A path standing outside `akasha` is refused before anything is written.
The bodies a write puts and the paths that write takes away are stated apart.
Every body a write puts and every path a write takes away lands through a change page.
A write putting the body a path already holds writes nothing.
A path taken away that has no body refuses the write.
A batch is authored by the writer whose write arrived first.
Every writer a batch has is named in the message.
Two writes in one batch reaching one path leave the later one standing.
A batch refused is refused whole.
A write may state the commit its bodies were read against.
The commit a write states is taken by any name git resolves to a commit.
The commit a write states is carried through to the landing.
A write stating a commit is refused where a path no longer has the body that commit had.
A write stating a commit lands in a batch of its own.
A write stating no commit is taken as read against the bodies now standing.
A page a write creates has the values its page type generates.
A body is formatted before the body lands.
A value kept outside the commit is merged onto the values its page already keeps.
Two writes in one batch keeping one page merge in the order the writes arrived.
A value kept outside the commit is written after the commit its write landed.
A write refused commits nothing and keeps nothing.
A write that throws is refused naming the paths that write carried.
A write that threw after it committed names that commit beside those paths.
A write carrying only values kept outside the commit lands no commit.
The page a value is kept for is judged for its path as a body would be.

definition: a write handed to the pages, and the commit it lands as
